cases.name: LaShan Ann Muhlinghaus
cases.about: She was a junior at Texas A & M.
cases.narrative:
Her body was found in her apartment. He stabbed her 4 times in the back and when she turned around he pushed her to the floor and stabbed her until she was dead, 25 times total. He sexually assaulted (had intercourse with) her body after she was deceased and mutilated her lower body.

She had returned home and he was already inside, and had entered her apartment using a stolen pass key.   When she entered the apartment, he hid in her roommate's closet.
